raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

DSpark's confidence-scheduled ("ragged") verification trims low-survival draft
tokens before the target verify, but it needs a trained confidence head, so
checkpoints without one cannot use it. vLLM's
[online acceptance estimator](https://vllm.ai/blog/2026-10-14-adaptive-verification-online-estimator)
(vllm-project/vllm#52228) replaces the head with a logistic model of the draft
distribution fitted while serving. This PR brings that to SGLang, with a more
robust fit.

## Modifications

- `--speculative-dspark-confidence-source {auto,head,online}` (default `auto`).
  `online` scores each draft position with
  `sigmoid(slope * logit(q_max) + intercept[position])`; `auto` uses the trained
  head when the checkpoint ships one and the estimator otherwise (config
  `enable_confidence_head: false`, or no confidence weights at all).
- `OnlineAcceptanceEstimator` (`srt/speculative/online_acceptance_estimator.py`):
  DSpark drafts and verifies in the same step, so prediction and grading run back
  to back with no per-request state. Labels are the drafts before and at the first
  rejection, restricted to drafts checked against a real target row.
- Fit: exact MAP IRLS on binned `(position, logit(q_max) bin, label)` counts with
  a decayed history (Newton iterations with a batched line search, on device, every
  100 steps). A single Newton step per round, as in vLLM, freezes the slope and
  over-predicts survival when acceptance saturates below 1 for confident drafts
  (sampled targets): in simulation it over-predicted the expected accepted length
  by 0.45 tokens per request, the binned fit by -0.02.
- Two launches per decode step: a Triton pass computes logit(q_max) and the
  prediction together, and one atomic-add kernel bins the labels.
- Fix (pre-existing on main): compact ragged verify padded the trimmed slots of the
  full-width logits with zeros, and the sampling accept's top-p renormalization of a
  uniform row is flashinfer's radix top-p worst case (22 ms vs 0.75 ms for 512 x 152k
  rows). On Qwen3-14B + DSpark at c=64 that was ~15 ms of a 36 ms step and made compact
  ~50% slower than static, whatever the confidence source. Padding rows now hold a point
  mass (they are never accepted from; block verification is lossless for any padding).
- Docs: a confidence-scheduled verification section and the new server argument.

## Losslessness

Trimming is lossless iff whether position i is verified depends only on the
drafts before i (plus independent randomness and history). The estimator's
feature reads `q_i`, never the drafted token; survival is a running product over
positions <= i; ties in the top-B break toward earlier positions; and the budget
is sized from confidences two steps old. An exact rational enumeration (not part of
this PR) confirms
losslessness for token-wise and block verification (and shows the failure modes:
scoring `q(x_i)`, or sizing the budget from current survivals of a
semi-autoregressive drafter). `test_ragged_cutoff_preserves_distribution` checks
the real accept kernels on 400k rows with compact padding and the verify cap,
block and token-wise.

## Accuracy Tests

sgl-eval 0.1.3 gsm8k (full 1319, 64 concurrent), Qwen3-14B thinking mode, T=0.6, top-p 0.95,
max 16384 tokens, with the compact scheduler and a profiled SPS table:

| static (verify all) | head | online | online + block verification |
|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| 96.29% | 96.21% | 96.13% | 96.29% |

## Benchmarking and Profiling

Qwen3-14B + `deepseek-ai/dspark_qwen3_14b_block7`, 1x B300 per arm, trtllm_mha / fa4,
SPEED-Bench throughput_1k per category, T=1.0, top-p 0.95, up to 1024 output tokens, prompts =
4 x concurrency. Cells: output throughput vs static (accept length). `head` uses the checkpoint's
trained confidence head, `online` this PR's estimator; both run the same compact scheduler and
SPS table, with the padding fix.

@@ -431,6 +431,32 @@ Greedy requests keep their existing verification behavior.
 Block verification adds vocabulary reductions during verification. Benchmark your
 model and workload to measure the effect on latency and throughput.
 
+---
+
+## Confidence-scheduled verification (DSpark)
+
+With `SGLANG_RAGGED_VERIFY_MODE=compact`, a DSpark server verifies only a prefix of
+each request's draft. Every draft position gets a confidence; a running product
+along the draft gives its survival, and the step's verify budget goes to the most
+likely slots across the batch. The budget is sized against a step-cost table that
+`python -m sglang.benchmark.dspark_sps_profiler` measures for your model and GPU;
+pass it with `--speculative-dspark-sps-table-path`. Without a table every draft
+token is verified.
+
+`--speculative-dspark-confidence-source` picks where the confidences come from:
+
+- `head`: the trained confidence head that DSpark checkpoints may ship.
+- `online`: an estimator fitted while serving,
+  `sigmoid(slope * logit(q_max) + intercept[position])`, where `q_max` is the draft
+  distribution's top probability. It refits every 100 decode steps from the target's
+  accept/reject outcomes, so it calibrates to the model pair and the live workload.
+- `auto` (default): the head when the checkpoint ships one, otherwise `online`.
+
+Both sources are lossless. A position's confidence never reads the token drafted
+there, and the budget is sized from confidences two decode steps old, so trimming
+cannot select on the drafted tokens. The trimmed draft composes with
+`--speculative-use-block-verification`.
+
 ## Multi Token Prediction
 
 We support [MTP (Multi-Token Prediction)](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2404.19737) in SGLang by using speculative decoding. We use `XiaomiMiMo/MiMo-7B-RL` as an example here (for DeepSeek MTP usage, refer to [DeepSeek-V3.2 cookbook §4.2.3](/cookbook/autoregressive/DeepSeek/DeepSeek-V3_2#4-2-3-multi-token-prediction-eagle-speculative-decoding)).

+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import torch
+import triton
+import triton.language as tl
+
+from sglang.kernels.ops.speculative.dspark.dispatch import inputs_on_cuda
+
+# A row carrying all its mass on one token sends the log-odds to infinity.
+MAX_LOG_ODDS = 40.0
+
+
+class DraftTopLogOdds:
+    """logit(q_max) of each draft row's temperature-scaled distribution."""
+
+    @classmethod
+    def execute(cls, *args, **kwargs) -> torch.Tensor:
+        if inputs_on_cuda(*args, **kwargs):
+            return draft_top_log_odds(*args, **kwargs)
+        return draft_top_log_odds_torch(*args, **kwargs)
+
+
+class PredictAcceptance:
+    """[rows] features logit(q_max) and acceptance predictions
+    sigmoid(slope * feature + intercepts[row % rows_per_request])."""
+
+    @classmethod
+    def execute(cls, *args, **kwargs) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
+        if inputs_on_cuda(*args, **kwargs):
+            return predict_acceptance(*args, **kwargs)
+        return predict_acceptance_torch(*args, **kwargs)
+
+
+class AccumulateBinCounts:
+    """Adds one graded block into [gamma, num_bins, (graded, accepted)] counts."""
+
+    @classmethod
+    def execute(cls, *args, **kwargs) -> None:
+        if inputs_on_cuda(*args, **kwargs):
+            return accumulate_bin_counts(*args, **kwargs)
+        return accumulate_bin_counts_torch(*args, **kwargs)
+
+
+def predict_acceptance_torch(
+    *,
+    logits: torch.Tensor,
+    temperatures: torch.Tensor,
+    rows_per_request: int,
+    slope: torch.Tensor,
+    intercepts: torch.Tensor,
+) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
+    features = draft_top_log_odds_torch(
+        logits=logits, temperatures=temperatures, rows_per_request=rows_per_request
+    )
+    position_intercepts = intercepts.repeat(logits.shape[0] // rows_per_request)
+    return features, torch.sigmoid(slope * features + position_intercepts)
+
+
+def accumulate_bin_counts_torch(
+    *,
+    counts: torch.Tensor,
+    features: torch.Tensor,
+    num_correct_drafts: torch.Tensor,
+    num_graded_drafts: torch.Tensor,
+    bin_low: float,
+    bin_width: float,
+) -> None:
+    """``features``: [bs, gamma]. Draft k of a request is graded when
+    k <= num_correct and k < num_graded, and accepted when k < num_correct."""
+    gamma, num_bins, _ = counts.shape
+    positions = torch.arange(gamma, device=features.device).view(1, -1)
+    num_correct = num_correct_drafts.view(-1, 1).to(positions.dtype)
+    num_graded = num_graded_drafts.view(-1, 1).to(positions.dtype)
+    graded = ((positions <= num_correct) & (positions < num_graded)).to(counts.dtype)
+    accepted = graded * (positions < num_correct).to(counts.dtype)
+    bins = torch.clamp(((features - bin_low) / bin_width).floor(), 0, num_bins - 1)
+    flat = (positions * num_bins + bins.long()).view(-1)
+    flat_counts = counts.view(-1, 2)
+    flat_counts[:, 0].index_add_(0, flat, graded.view(-1))
+    flat_counts[:, 1].index_add_(0, flat, accepted.view(-1))
+
+
+def draft_top_log_odds_torch(
+    *,
+    logits: torch.Tensor,
+    temperatures: torch.Tensor,
+    rows_per_request: int,
+) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """``logits``: [bs * rows_per_request, vocab]; ``temperatures``: [bs]."""
+    num_rows = logits.shape[0]
+    temp_per_row = torch.repeat_interleave(
+        temperatures.reshape(-1).to(torch.float32), rows_per_request, dim=0
+    )
+    assert temp_per_row.numel() == num_rows
+    scaled = logits.to(torch.float32) / temp_per_row[:, None]
+    row_max = scaled.max(dim=-1, keepdim=True).values
+    sum_exp = torch.exp(scaled - row_max).sum(dim=-1)
+    # The top token contributes exactly e^0 = 1, so the rest sum to sum_exp - 1
+    # and logit(q_max) = log(1 / (sum_exp - 1)).
+    complement = torch.clamp(sum_exp - 1.0, min=0.0)
+    return torch.clamp(-torch.log(complement), min=-MAX_LOG_ODDS, max=MAX_LOG_ODDS)
+
+
+@triton.jit
+def _draft_top_log_odds_kernel(
+    logits_ptr,
+    temp_ptr,
+    out_ptr,
+    vocab,
+    rows_per_request,
+    logits_row_stride,
+    slope_ptr,
+    intercepts_ptr,
+    pred_ptr,
+    MAX_ODDS: tl.constexpr,
+    BLOCK_V: tl.constexpr,
+    PREDICT: tl.constexpr,
+):
+    row = tl.program_id(0)
+    temp = tl.load(temp_ptr + row // rows_per_request).to(tl.float32)
+    base = logits_ptr + row.to(tl.int64) * logits_row_stride
+
+    row_max = -float("inf")
+    sum_exp = 0.0
+    for v0 in range(0, vocab, BLOCK_V):

+"""Online-fitted acceptance estimator for confidence-scheduled verification.
+
+Predicts each draft position's acceptance probability from the draft
+distribution alone, ``p = sigmoid(slope * logit(q_max) + intercept[k])``, and
+refits the shared slope and per-position intercepts on the target's
+accept/reject outcomes while serving. The feature reads only ``q_k``, which
+depends on the drafts before position ``k`` and never on the drafted token
+itself, so trimming verification on it stays lossless. Scoring the drawn
+token's probability instead would select on the proposal and bias the output
+toward the drafter's confident modes.
+
+Labels are binned by (position, feature) and kept with a decayed history; each

+cheaper but unstable: a confidently wrong prediction carries a full residual and

+        )
+        features, predictions = PredictAcceptance.execute(
+            logits=step_logits.reshape(bs * gamma, vocab),
+            temperatures=feature_temperatures,
+            rows_per_request=gamma,
+            slope=self.slope,
+            intercepts=self.intercepts,
+        )

+            counts=self._round_counts,

+            num_graded_drafts=num_graded_drafts,
+            bin_low=_BIN_LOW,

+        """Drop the last prediction ungraded (e.g. its outcome was simulated)."""

+
+    def _refit(self) -> None:

+        self.intercepts.copy_(intercepts)
+        self._steps_since_refit = 0
+        self.num_refits += 1

+    def _log_round(self) -> None:
+        graded, accepted = self._round_counts.unbind(dim=-1)
+        predictions = torch.sigmoid(
+            self.slope * self._bin_centers.view(1, -1) + self.intercepts.view(-1, 1)
+        )
+        num_graded = graded.sum(dim=1)
+        denom = num_graded.clamp(min=1.0)
+        logger.info(
+            "Online acceptance estimator refit %d: slope=%.4f intercepts=%s "
+            "graded=%s observed_accept=%s mean_pred=%s",
+            self.num_refits + 1,
+            float(self.slope.item()),
+            _fmt(self.intercepts),
+            num_graded.to(torch.int64).tolist(),
+            _fmt(accepted.sum(dim=1) / denom),
+            _fmt((graded * predictions).sum(dim=1) / denom),
+        )
+
+
+def _fit_binned(
+    *,
+    counts: torch.Tensor,
+    centers: torch.Tensor,
+    slope: torch.Tensor,
+    intercepts: torch.Tensor,
+    prior_weight: float,
+    num_iters: int,
+) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
+    """Penalized maximum likelihood on binned labels. Each Newton iteration
+    solves the arrowhead system (the slope row couples to every position, each
+    intercept only to itself) in closed form, then backtracks along the step.
+    At the optimum each position's mean prediction matches its observed
+    acceptance up to the prior, which is what the verify budget sums."""
+    graded, accepted = counts[..., 0], counts[..., 1]
+    f = centers.view(1, -1)
+    prior_slope, prior_intercepts = slope.clone(), intercepts.clone()
+    scales = torch.tensor(_STEP_SCALES, device=centers.device)
+    for _ in range(num_iters):
+        p = torch.sigmoid(slope * f + intercepts.view(-1, 1))
+        weight = graded * p * (1.0 - p)
+        residual = accepted - graded * p
+        b_k = (weight * f).sum(dim=1)
+        c_k = weight.sum(dim=1) + prior_weight
+        h_k = residual.sum(dim=1) - prior_weight * (intercepts - prior_intercepts)
+        a = (weight * f * f).sum() + prior_weight
+        g = (residual * f).sum() - prior_weight * (slope - prior_slope)
+        d_slope = (g - (b_k * h_k / c_k).sum()) / (a - (b_k * b_k / c_k).sum())
+        d_intercepts = (h_k - b_k * d_slope) / c_k
+        cand_slope = torch.clamp(slope + scales * d_slope, min=0.0)
+        cand_intercepts = intercepts.view(1, -1) + scales.view(-1, 1) * d_intercepts
+        z = cand_slope.view(-1, 1, 1) * f.view(1, 1, -1) + cand_intercepts.unsqueeze(-1)
+        nll = (graded * F.softplus(z) - accepted * z).sum(dim=(1, 2))
+        nll = nll + 0.5 * prior_weight * (
+            (cand_slope - prior_slope) ** 2
+            + ((cand_intercepts - prior_intercepts) ** 2).sum(dim=1)
+        )
+        nll = torch.where(torch.isfinite(nll), nll, torch.full_like(nll, float("inf")))
+        best = torch.argmin(nll)
+        slope = cand_slope[best].view(1)
+        intercepts = cand_intercepts[best]
+    return slope, intercepts
+
+
+def _should_log_refit(refit: int) -> bool:
+    return refit in (1, 10) or refit % 50 == 0

+def _fmt(values: torch.Tensor) -> str:
+    return "[" + ", ".join(f"{float(v):.3f}" for v in values.cpu()) + "]"

+    def test_calibrated_in_the_large_when_acceptance_saturates(self):
+        """Acceptance of a confident draft tops out at the target's own entropy,
+        which logit(q_max) cannot express. Each position's mean prediction must
+        still match its observed acceptance: the budget sums these."""
+        torch.manual_seed(2)
+        gamma, bs, steps, ceiling = 3, 128, 1500, 0.8
+        true_intercepts = torch.tensor([0.5, 0.0, -0.5])
+        est = self._estimator(gamma=gamma)
+
+        def batch():
+            confident = torch.rand(bs, 1) < 0.5
+            centers = torch.where(confident, torch.tensor(12.0), torch.tensor(1.0))
+            features = (centers + torch.randn(bs, gamma) * 3.0).clamp(min=0.0)
+            accept_prob = ceiling * torch.sigmoid(0.5 * features + true_intercepts)
+            return features, accept_prob
+
+        for _ in range(steps):
+            features, accept_prob = batch()
+            est.predict(
+                step_logits=_two_token_logits(features),
+                temperatures=torch.ones(bs),
+                greedy_mask=torch.zeros(bs, dtype=torch.bool),
+            )
+            accepted = torch.rand(bs, gamma) < accept_prob
+            est.observe(
+                num_correct_drafts=torch.cumprod(accepted.long(), dim=1).sum(dim=1),
+                num_graded_drafts=torch.full((bs,), gamma),
+            )
+        features, accept_prob = batch()
+        predicted = est.predict(
+            step_logits=_two_token_logits(features),
+            temperatures=torch.ones(bs),
+            greedy_mask=torch.zeros(bs, dtype=torch.bool),
+        )
+        est.skip_observe()
+        # Expected accepted drafts per request, the quantity the budget ranks.
+        expected = torch.cumprod(accept_prob, dim=1).sum(dim=1).mean()
+        self.assertAlmostEqual(
+            float(torch.cumprod(predicted, dim=1).sum(dim=1).mean()),
+            float(expected),
+            delta=0.08,
+        )
